onset.Description: When the CS was presented or imagery began

duration.Description: Total duration of visual stimulus or imagery epoch of a trial

trial_type.Description: Describes which CS and whether it was viewed or imagined

cs-type.LongName: Type of CS, CS+ or CS-
cs-type.Description: Describes whether the CS was CS+ or CS-, irrespective of other factors

cs-number.Description: Describes which CS+ later undergoes imagery extinction, number 2 denotes CS+2 which undergoes imagery extinction

shock.Description: Describes whether shock was present on the trial

percept.Description: Describes whether the stimulus was viewed or imagined on a given trial

letter.Description: The viewed and imagined letter stimuli used in the experiment

TrialOn.Description: Onset time of the first fixation of the trial began

ItiOn.Description: When the inter-trial interval began, which is the offset of view/imagining the CS
